reference: F.layer_norm(x, normalized_shape, weight, bias, eps) in f64, rounded once to the dtype
notes: x is fed as a transposed view: uploaded with its last two dims swapped, then transposed back. f16/bf16 compute in f32 (graph-ir.md §3.1.8). out is computed in f64 from the inputs and params and rounded once to the dtype under test, so the bytes don't depend on the CPU's kernels; torch in the dtype itself meets the tolerance (checked by the generator).
